fix: Bearer = counted part (stamen), container = flower, quality PATO:0000070 amount with an indefinite value ('numerous'|'many'|'few'|'several') and its cue, no data range. OWL keeps only the presence of the part (has part some (stamen and part of some flower)); the indefinite count stays in RDF (fb:indefiniteCount "numerous"), since 'numerous' has no fixed threshold across taxa.

fix: Split 'multi-/pluri-' + 'flores/flowered' using the 'flowered → flower' row of config/flora_counted_parts.tsv: bearer flower, container capitulum, quality amount with indefinite value 'many'. The indefinite value goes in RDF; OWL states only has part flower.
reason: Same construction as 'numerous stamens'; the prefix gives an indefinite count, not a number.

fix: 'white suffused pink' = base colour white plus a secondary tint pink (suffused/tinged/flushed). Slots: base colour, tint colour, tint cue.
